subject: general
question:
In a certain code language,

A+B means ‘A is the mother of B, 

A-B means ‘A is the brother of B, 

A x B means ‘A is the wife of B’, 

A÷B means ‘A is the father of B, 

and A # B means 'A is the daughter of B'. 

How is R related to T if ‘Q#R × P÷K × T"?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 #
 
 

 Meaning
 Mother
 Brother
 Wife
 Father
 Daughter 
 
 

 

Given: Q # R × P ÷ K × T

It means: Q is the daughter of R, R is the wife of P, P is the father of K and K is the wife of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6eab68daef2eff366ed2b46399e0fdaf8ffb8cc93bad0ae31c6bb9001f607d9d.png] 

So, R is the **Wife's mother** of T.

Hence, the correct answer is "Wife's mother".
